title: UDLM Named-Walk Registry
description: The shape of registry/walks.yaml: the named walks and the steps each one follows (service-dependencies.md §6.5, DEP-019). This schema checks the shape only. tests/check_walks.py proves every class, relationship and field a step names against the classes.

walks.description: Which running things carry what an advisory names.

class_name.description: A class by its registered name. A Base name also stands for its Types: `Machine` covers `Machine.VM`.

record_path.description: A path into a state record, from `fields` or `outputs`. `[]` after a segment reads every item of an array.

walk.description: The walk's name. A consumer cites it.

start.description: The class the walk starts from. A consumer may also enter at any class a later step reads from.

step.description: The step's name, unique within its walk.

from.description: The class of the records in hand.

via.description: `relationship`: one relationship a class declares by name. `field_reference`: a reference a class holds in a field. `join`: two records that state the same value, matched when read and never stored.

declared_on.description: The class whose records hold the edge or the field.

edge_type.description: The relationship's edge type, restated from the class and proven equal by the gate.

read.description: `forward`: follow the edge from the record that holds it. `reverse`: find the records that hold an edge, or a field, pointing at the record in hand.

target_key_scheme.description: The natural-key scheme an observed edge of this step carries, where the target class has exactly one. One of the `correlation_ids` schemes.

field.description: The field that holds the reference.

from_field.description: The value stated on the record in hand.

to_field.description: The same value stated on the record reached.

read_state.description: Which record of the reached entity is compared. `observed`: its newest Discovered or Realized record, never an Intent.

yields.description: What a reached record is in the answer. `evidence`: on the path, says why. `affected`: a thing that runs or carries the software; these are the affected set. `service`: the unit people own that affected things make up.
